modes.name: clause_lifting
modes.instruction: Take frame OR clauses and lift them to implications. Delete literals conservatively to generalize.

modes.name: family_compression
modes.instruction: Take multiple lifted lemmas with same consequent and propose a broader generalization covering them all.

modes.name: guard_strengthening
modes.instruction: Take failed candidates and propose stronger guards based on the failure context.

modes.name: repair
modes.instruction: Repair failed candidates. Weaken overly strong consequents. Add guards. Change schemas conservatively.

modes.name: transition_causal
modes.instruction: Propose lemmas with guards derived from transition logic. Use known variable dependencies.

modes.name: mixed_generalization
modes.instruction: Mix operators. Lift clauses, delete literals, compress families, repair failures.
